SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
S.1, Special branch XXXXX
REPORT
Date February 16, 19 40.

Subject Denny S STRYER.

Made by. D.F.S. Killingoeck, Forwarded by. D.I. Crawford.

With reference to the attached communication
from U.S.A. Consulate-General concerning Denny
S STRYER, a search of records on file at Police
Headquarters has failed to reveal anything to the
detriment of this man's character.

He arrived in Shanghai on February 15, 1939
and first came to the notice of this office during
January 1940, when he presented Certificate of
Identity 047/39, issued by the "I.J." Relief
Committee, for police endorsement. As the I.J.
Committee have since issued a new type of certificate,
Stryer has since applied for endorsement of
Certificate No. 014/40, the old certificate having
been cancelled by the Committee.

Stryer is engaged in business as a manufacturers
agent in Shanghai and is at present endeavouring to
arrange for the immigration of his wife, from Europe
into Shanghai. It is believed that his wife is non
Jewish although Stryer himself is a Jew.

Stryer has a mother, brother and sister all
resident in Shanghai.

Killingoeck
D. F. S.

A.C. (Special Branch).

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号............
S.1，特务科 XXXXX
报告
日期：1940年2月16日。

主题：丹尼·S·斯特赖尔（Denny S STRYER）。

制作人：D.F.S. Killingoeck，转呈人：D.I. Crawford。

关于随附的美国总领事馆就丹尼·S·斯特赖尔（Denny S STRYER）一事发出的函件，经查阅警务处总部存档记录，未发现任何有损此人品行之记录。

他于1939年2月15日抵达上海，并于1940年1月首次引起本处注意，当时他出示了由“国际犹太难民委员会”（"I.J." Relief Committee）签发的第047/39号身份证明书，请求警方背书。鉴于该国际犹太难民委员会此后已签发新型证书，斯特赖尔遂申请对第014/40号证书进行背书，旧证书已被该委员会注销。

斯特赖尔在上海从事制造商代理业务，目前正努力安排其妻子从欧洲移民至上海。据信其妻子非犹太人，尽管斯特赖尔本人是犹太人。

斯特赖尔有一位母亲、一位兄弟和一位姐妹，均居住在上海。

Killingoeck
D. F. S.

助理 commissioner （特务科）。

PASSPORT & REGISTRATION OFFICE,
BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O. BOX 259,
SHANGHAI.
17th January, 1940.

Dear Mr. Robertson,

A Stateless "Ex-Pole", named Stryer Denny called on
me to-day for a visa to visit his brother in Tel-Aviv,
Palestine. He holds Certificate of Identity 7374/0471/39
countersigned by you on the 16th January and gave his
address as 211/9 Avenue Haig and his occupation as "merchant".

I explained to him that his application would have to
be referred to Palestine and as this will take about three
months he said "it would too late and that he would go away
and think it over."

As he may return again with a request for me to forward
his application I should be grateful for any information you
could let me have about him for the information of the
Palestinian Authorities.

Yours sincerely,

Fox

T. Robertson, Esq.,
Deputy Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

D.P.: Europe
C.E.

护照及登记办公室，
英国驻上海总领事馆，
邮政信箱 259，
上海。
1940年1月17日。

亲爱的罗伯逊先生：

今日，一名名为丹尼·斯特赖尔（Stryer Denny）的无国籍“前波兰人”前来拜访我，申请签证以便前往巴勒斯坦特拉维夫探望其兄弟。他持有由您于1月16日副署的第7374/0471/39号身份证明书，并告知其住址为海格路211弄9号，职业为“商人”。

我向他解释称，其申请需转交巴勒斯坦方面处理，鉴于此过程约需三个月，他表示“那太晚了，他会回去再考虑一下。”

若他再次回来请求我将他的申请转递，如蒙提供有关他的任何信息，以便我向巴勒斯坦当局通报，我将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼，

福克斯

T. 罗伯逊 先生，
副总监，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

D.P.：欧洲
C.E.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section I, Special Branch. Station.
REPORT
File No.
Date February 17, 1940.

Subject H. J. Gruetzmacher - German.

Made by J. S. Pitts. Forwarded by J. I. Crawford.

（批：Copy sent）
（批：1/2）
（印：FILE）

Hans Juerger GRUETZMACHER, German aryan,
is an engineer in the employ of Messrs. Siemens
China Company, 233 Nanking Road. He has been a
resident of Shanghai for some three years having
arrived here from the Berlin office of the concern
of which he is now working.

A member of the local branch of the
N. S. D. A. P., GRUETZMACHER is well spoken of in
German circles in Shanghai. He is considered as
a quiet type of individual who does not indulge in
politics. He resides with his wife, Mrs. Lotte
G. GRUETZMACHER, at 16 Route de Grouchy.

J. S. Pitts.
D. S.

A. C. ( Special Branch ).

档案号。
日期：1940年2月17日。

主题：H. J. 格鲁茨马赫（Gruetzmacher） - 德国人。

制作人：J. S. Pitts。转呈人：J. I. Crawford。

（批注：副本已发送）
（批注：1/2）
（印章：归档）

汉斯·尤尔格·格鲁茨马赫（Hans Juerger GRUETZMACHER），德国雅利安人，系南京路233号西门子中国公司（Messrs. Siemens China Company）雇佣的工程师。他已在上海居住约三年，是从其目前任职公司的柏林办事处调派至此的。

作为纳粹党（N. S. D. A. P.）上海地方分支的成员，格鲁茨马赫在上海德侨圈中口碑良好。他被视为一种性格安静、不沉溺于政治的个人。他与妻子洛特·G·格鲁茨马赫夫人（Mrs. Lotte G. GRUETZMACHER）居住在格罗希路16号。

J. S. Pitts.
D. S.

助理 commissioner （特务科）。

"Y"

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No...
Section 1, Special Branch, Shanghai
REPORT
Date. February 20. 1940.

Subject. John Skeats Wilson - complaint re breach of confidence.

Made by. D. J. McKeown.    Forwarded by. M. I. Crawford.

On the evening of February 19, Mr. Irving Marantz,
manager of the Pacific American Trading Company, while
paying a friendly visit to my home, complained that
I had released information which was given to me by him
in confidence. Apparently Wilson, his employee, vice
attached report, was called to H.B.M. Consulate or
Embassy and during an interview was told facts concerning
himself which were known only to his manager and
himself. For instance, he was told that Marantz
intended to dismiss him at the end of the month and
his exact salary was revealed.

It was specifically stated in the Police report
that Wilson's impending dismissal was confidential
information. Following the interview Wilson went to
Marantz and complained that facts known only to himself
and Marantz had been revealed and the latter had no
excuse and was consequently justifiably annoyed with
me. The fact that he is a friend of mine saved me
from further trouble. The task of acquiring confidential
information regarding foreigners particularly those
with extraterritorial rights is sufficiently difficult,
and members of this office are dependent upon the good
will of friends. If they are to be exposed to the
folly of the recipients of information revealing the
source, the task will become increasingly difficult
apart from any legal consequences which may follow.

（印：C. 8% / FILE）

A.C. (Sp. Br.)    20 2 40
                  Ju
                  （签名：D. J. McKeown）
                  D. J.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案号...
第一科，特务科，上海
报告
日期：1940年2月20日。

主题：约翰·斯基茨·威尔逊（John Skeats Wilson） - 关于违反保密义务的投诉。

制作人：D. J. McKeown。    转呈人：M. I. Crawford。

2月19日晚，太平洋美国贸易公司经理欧文·马兰茨（Irving Marantz）先生在到我家友好拜访时，抱怨我泄露了他私下告知我的信息。显然，威尔逊（Wilson），即其雇员，见随附报告，被召至英国驻华领事馆或大使馆，并在面谈期间被告知了一些仅为其经理和他本人所知的事实。例如，他被告知马兰茨打算在月底解雇他，且其确切薪水也被透露。

警方报告中明确指出，威尔逊即将被解雇属于机密信息。面谈后，威尔逊去找马兰茨，抱怨仅为他二人所知的事实已被泄露，后者对此无法辩解，因此对我感到恼怒也是合情合理的。他是我的朋友这一事实使我免于进一步的麻烦。获取有关外国人（特别是那些享有治外法权者）的机密信息本就十分困难，本部门成员依赖于朋友们的善意。如果信息接收者愚蠢地暴露信息来源，使得这些朋友面临风险，那么除了可能随之而来的法律后果外，这项任务将变得愈发困难。

（印章：C. 8% / 归档）

助理 commissioner （特务科）    1940年2月20日
                  Ju
                  （签名：D. J. McKeown）
                  D. J.
